// CASE dart_chunk_collect_honest expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}
// CASE dart_chunk_literal_one expect=fire
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += 1) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(1);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}
// CASE dart_chunk_other_name expect=pass
Future<List<R>> saveAll<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}
// CASE dart_worker_literal_one expect=fire
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(
    List.generate(1, (_) async {
      while (next < items.length) {
        final index = next++;
        results[index] = await operation(items[index]);
      }
    }),
  );
  return results.cast<R>();
}
